title: Product Photo Lighting Without a Studio | AIVideosUGC
description: Lighting for glass, metal, and shine, made from one uploaded photo. Soften a hard snapshot, say where the light comes from, and keep bright spots clean.
h1: Product Photo Lighting for Glass, Metal and Gloss
lead: Product photo lighting starts from one clear photo. Say where the light comes from so glass, metal, and shine stay easy to see. Then you can start a clip with a voice, on-screen words (captions), or a generated person (an AI actor).
secondary_keywords: skincare product photo with soft light

steps.d: Upload a sharp photo of the whole product, including the edges that catch the light. A plain snapshot is enough.
Name where the light comes from, how soft the shadow is, and how the surface should look. You get a square photo.
Download the image and compare its outline, color, and surface with the real item. Add offer text in your own editor after download.

faq.q: Which products show a useful lighting change?
faq.a: Glass, metal, and shine. Perfume bottles, jars, watches, steel cups, and chains are typical. Compare every download with the real item.

faq.q: What is product photo lighting here?
faq.a: You upload one clear photo and describe the direction, the shadow, and the surface. Studio lighting for product photos comes back as a square file.

faq.q: Do I need a studio setup?
faq.a: No. A plain snapshot is enough. Name the light you want. You do not need stands or soft light boxes.

faq.q: Can I reduce glare on glass or metal?
faq.a: Yes. Ask for softer light or a smaller bright spot. Do not use a photo that changes the shape or the color.

faq.q: Will the new lighting change the shape or color?
faq.a: It can. Compare the outline, the color, and the surface with the real item at full size. Keep only a photo that still matches.

faq.q: Which light suits an Amazon listing?
faq.a: Even light from the front keeps a label easier to read. Keep stronger side light for an ad, not for the main Amazon photo.

faq.q: Can the lit photo start a video?
faq.a: Yes. The same photo can start a clip with an AI voice, captions, a script, and an AI actor. Publish that clip to TikTok, Instagram, or Facebook in one step.

faq.q: What does a lighting photo cost?
faq.a: Each photo is 24 credits. You see that cost before you start. If it fails, those credits come back. Starter is $24.50 a month with 200 credits. The download has no watermark.

faq.q: Can I light several photos at once?
faq.a: Yes. Run the same lighting words on many photos at once, or start them from your own software (the API). A clip made from a lit photo is a video: 24, 40, 60, or 120 credits for 6, 10, 15, or 30 seconds.

faq.q: Can I add offer text on the photo?
faq.a: Type the offer in your own editor after download. Captions on a clip can name the product, and you can still add a price yourself.

faq.q: Can I use the file in ads?
faq.a: Yes. The square photo and a clip made from it can run in your ads and on your pages. People in a clip are AI actors, so present that clip as your ad.
